theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (z e : Euclid P) (k : ℕ) (φ₀ : ℝ), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → z ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖z‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ z e = 0 → 1 ≤ k → 0 < φ₀ → (∀ φ : ℝ, 0 < φ → φ < φ₀ → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ C.support ∩ ball (Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e) ε = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball (Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e) ε ∧ ∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball (Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e) ε → HasMassDensity C y k) → Real.cos φ₀ • z + Real.sin φ₀ • e ∈ C.support ∧ HasMassDensity C (Real.cos φ₀ • z + Real.sin φ₀ • e) k
